descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Disease Area Lead (Oncology / Lung) is an empowered leader responsible for the respective DA business in Roche Turkiye, leveraging the global Roche network as an active catalyst. In this role, you will report to the Leadership Team Member responsible for all disease areas and develop a clear business strategy for identifying, leveraging, scaling, adapting, and executing the business by providing launch and commercial excellence for the DA portfolio. DA experience is required for this role. Key Responsibilities Establish strategic direction and lead the execution of the Strategy
• Responsible for setting the DA vision, high ambitions, and outcomes for the squad by harnessing insights from Primary Point of Contacts (PPOCs) and other key stakeholders across the enterprise. Holding overall accountability for delivering market leadership and the P&L, whilst working in the context of shared responsibility.
• Responsible for developing effective strategies to manage the lifecycle and the financial and resource planning for the products.
• Promote innovation and the development of projects and pull in resources from the broader Roche network to deliver value-added solutions.
• Maximize opportunities and synergize across other disease areas and establish a strong collaboration within the affiliate and cross-affiliates within Pharma International.
• Closely collaborate with stakeholders and customer-facing teams to translate disease area needs into clear execution.
• Ensure Cross-Functional Leadership by inspiring teams to meet ambitious outcomes, fostering an environment where cross-functional teams can collaborate, develop, and achieve outcomes
• Manage DA Members by embracing the role of recruiter, coach, and retainer of talent & performance, sharing the responsibility with leaders in other disciplines.
• Ensure the right resource prioritization, with an enterprise mindset, taking into account the affiliate strategy and portfolio priorities. Within this context, effectively prioritize DA outcomes and ensure resource requirements are met to deliver outcomes
• In collaboration with the PPOCs, ensure that key stakeholders are well-supported and view us as their preferred partner. Mobilize the network with speed when necessary to meet the urgent needs of these key stakeholders. People Leadership & Mindset
• Provide Inspirational leadership by uniting people around a shared vision and a common purpose, inspiring them to achieve squad-aligned outcomes. Ensure individuals and teams are developing and growing in line with the needs of the organization
• Build High-Performing Teams that deliver business outcomes by promoting a collaborative, innovative & creative environment
• Stay at the leading edge of learning & adapting according to external insights (strategy, outcomes & execution) for impact
• Ensure clarification of outcomes for the team so everyone is aligned on their role in delivering ambitious outcomes, and play an active role in execution as required.
• Act as a People Manager of Patient Journey Partners (PJP), and you are a thought partner for all DA members and others in the DA to bring perspective as a matrix lead. The role embraces the performance dynamics of all members.
• Have a very strong Entrepreneurial Mindset (We before Me) with outstanding partnering & leadership capabilities (coaching, consulting, ability to deeply listen, question, and understand).
• A catalyst and mobilize appropriate resources around common goals/outcomes to genera
